title: KOReader
intro: Read your Books library on a Kobo, Kindle or other e-reader running KOReader: browse and download books from the device, and pick up where you left off, on the device or in the browser.
step1: Download the plugin and copy the backissue.koplugin folder from the zip into KOReader's plugins folder on the device, then restart KOReader.
step2: In KOReader open the top menu, then Tools → BackIssue. The server address is already filled in; paste a personal key from API key on this page.
step3: Use Browse library to download books. Progress syncs when you open and close a book; Automatic sync can be switched off there.

koreader.description: KOReader companion: browse and download your Books library on an e-reader and keep reading progress in sync, exact between KOReader devices and by percentage with the web reader
